parts.text: I do: we compare three chairs, so we need -est: smallest.
Labelled model: Opening: Dear Diary, | When: Today | What happened (I or my): someone ate my porridge. | Feeling: I felt sad.

questions.q: Add -est: My chair was the (small) chair.
questions.model: I do: we compare three chairs, so we need -est: smallest.

questions.q: Add -er: Daddy Bear's bowl was (hot) than mine.
Change to Baby Bear: Goldilocks broke his chair.
write a diary entry as Baby Bear with Dear Diary and two sentences using I or my
questions.a: For example: Dear Diary, Someone sat on my chair. It broke into bits.
